title: Flat base change preserves perfect morphisms of schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: A flat base change of a perfect morphism of schemes is perfect; algebraically, for a perfect ring map A -> B and flat A -> A', the map A' -> B x_A A' is perfect. The retained proof splits perfect = pseudo-coherent + finite tor dimension: the pseudo-coherent half is cited verbatim to the in-source flat-base-change-pseudo-coherent lemma (a wave-23 candidate), the tor-dimension half to More on Algebra, flat-base-change-finite-tor-dimension; the two halves combine into perfection of the base change. Retained author proof at lines 17748-17757.
